Package com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.persistence

Class KfeBalanceMovementRecorder

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.ledger.adapters.out.persistence.KfeBalanceMovementRecorder
@Component public class KfeBalanceMovementRecorder extends Object
Persists legacy balance movement rows and handles duplicate races for idempotent credit types. Other integrity violations propagate so callers cannot mistake unrelated failures for duplicates.

  • Method Details

    • record

      public boolean record(UUID transactionId, UUID walletId, String movementType, long amountSats, String fromBucket, String toBucket)
      Persists one balance movement, prechecking idempotent types and handling their uniqueness race. A duplicate credit returns false; violations for other movement types are rethrown.
      Parameters:
      transactionId - operation/transaction identity, nullable for uncorrelated movements
      walletId - wallet receiving the movement
      movementType - persisted movement type name
      amountSats - movement amount in satoshis
      fromBucket - source bucket name, nullable where the movement has no source
      toBucket - destination bucket name, nullable where the movement has no destination
      Returns:
      true if a new row was written; false if skipped as duplicate credit
      Throws:
      org.springframework.dao.DataIntegrityViolationException - for non-idempotent constraint violations
